newest.headline: The launcher that fits your screen
items: Every news post has its own banner art now, and announcements sit at the top of the tab.
The home screen scales to the window it is in: no buttons on the art, no clipped news card.
CurseForge lists Bedrock content before you search, with each project's own picture.
XAPK and zip packages install, and the import shows its progress.
Friend requests show up, and friends who run Caramel wear the badge.
This build updates over the last one instead of asking you to delete it first.

upcoming.headline: What is being worked on next

items.text: The sign-in hand-off for Bedrock 1.26.60, which still needs a real phone and a real Microsoft account to confirm.
The replay recorder capturing the full world from BerryAPI's native world feed, not only the local player and voice peers.
BerryAPI's encrypted voice system, replacing the launcher's own relay settings.
